  • 🟢 Good News: Oil prices easing toward pre‑war levels.

Situation Brief – Last 6 hours (Day 27)

  • Immediate: No active sirens or confirmed incoming strikes reported in past 6 hours.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon):
    • IDF vehicle overturned during Lebanon operation; 1 soldier KIA, 1 injured. Northern front active daily.
  • Air & logistics:
    • Multiple military flights tracked (C‑130, RCH platforms). Syria airports reported closed.
  • US/Israel – Iran campaign:
    • Trump announced a second 10‑day pause on energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET). He cites Iranian request and “talks going well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
    • Earlier 5‑day pause was violated by strikes on Isfahan/Khorramshahr — risk of repeat violations remains.
    • US Senate voted to halt the Iran war — a concrete political constraint. Trump is still requesting additional war funding.
  • Diplomacy & regional politics:
    • Sen. Rubio touring Gulf, met leaders; seeking Gulf backing against an Iran deal and security guarantees.
    • Netherlands PM Rutte engaging to ease Trump–NATO rift ahead of summit.
  • Iran domestic & economics:
    • Iranians observed first Ashura since Khamenei’s killing; public mood tense.
    • Oil eased to pre‑war levels; Indian markets up. Iran allowing Hormuz passage for Russia/India/China while blocking others — trade/energy flows shifting.
  • Information & morale:
    • Reports of wounded US soldiers accusing Pentagon of downplaying injuries. Trump disputes attribution for strike on girls' school.
  • Sanctions/legal:
    • EU/UK guidance issued on new US General Licence X affecting Iran-related operators.
  • 🟢 Good News: US Senate vote to halt the war gives a tangible political brake on further executive action.

Threat assessment: escalating

Pakistan is mediating. Note: the first 5-day pause was violated earlier (strikes on Isfahan, Khorramshahr).

Situation Report — Day 27

Active strikes/sirens: Ongoing US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets; daily Hezbollah rocket/raid activity on Israel’s northern border.
  • Northern Border: Daily Hezbollah attacks and IDF operations. IDF vehicle accident during Lebanon operation killed one soldier; Israel reported killing two in Lebanon. Talks on southern-Lebanon “pilot zones” remain stalled.
  • Iran air campaign & pauses: Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iranian energy strikes — 10 days, until Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET — claiming an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. First 5-day pause was violated hours later when US/Israeli jets struck Isfahan and Khorramshahr. Pakistan mediating.
  • US political/military moves: US White House requested $87.6bn including Iran war funding; Trump asked Congress for more war funds. US Senate voted to halt the Iran war (procedural rebuke).
  • Hormuz / maritime: Iran permits passage only for select states (Russia, India, China); other shipping still blocked or restricted.
  • Diplomacy & alliances: GOP delegation (Rubio) touring Gulf seeking support. NATO friction with US leadership; Dutch PM seeking to ease rift. EU/UK operators reviewing new US general licence guidance on Iran sanctions.
  • Regional impact: Syrian airports reported closed. Civilian casualties: Defense Ministry contractor killed in Gaza building collapse; isolated security incidents in West Bank (IDF soldier found handcuffed).
  • 🟢 Good News: Second pause announced and Pakistan mediation create a diplomatic opening; US Senate rebuke signals domestic pressure to limit escalation.
Threat assessment: Escalating

  • קמפיין אווירי נגד איראן והפוגות: טראמפ הכריז על הפוגה שנייה בפגיעות באנרגיה — 10 ימים עד 6.4.2026, 20:00 ET — לטענתו לפי בקשת איראן. איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. ההפוגה הקודמת (5 ימים) הופרה כשמטסים אמריקאיים/ישראליים תקפו אספהאן וח'ורמסהאר.

  • מפרץ הורמוז / ימי: איראן מאפשרת מעבר ספינות נבחרות (רוסיה, הודו, סין); שאר התעבורה מוגבלת.
  • דיפלומטיה ובריתות: ריביו בסיור במפרץ לחיזוק תמיכה. מתחים בתוך נאט"ו; ראש ממשלת הולנד מנסה להרגיע. תיאום רגולטורי באירופה ובבריטניה בנוגע לרישיונות סנקציות אמריקאיות.
